<div class="wv-epigraph">{{spoiler|book=lh-01-the-captain|“It was my understanding that we were competing for control of The Last Horizon,” she said.}}<div class="wv-epigraph-cite">{{spoiler|book=lh-01-the-captain|— ''The Captain'', chapter 15}}</div></div>
''See also: [[Queen Shyrax Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|[[Queen]] [[Shyrax the Third]] is the rightful sovereign of the planet [[Karosha]]. A nine-foot-tall [[Karoshan]] with bronze skin and glowing golden hair-cables, she is a formidable leader characterized by her intense pursuit of victory and commanding presence. Her reign began nine years ago following the abdication of her mother, Shyrax the Second, but she was later convicted of treason by the [[Dragon Court]]. This led to her cousin, [[Felrex]], seizing the [[throne]] as [[King Regent]]. Shyrax views [[Felrex]] as a usurper and has sought to reclaim her position, even having physically cast her mother aside for failing the [[Karoshan people]]. As a warrior and commander, Shyrax possesses diverse combat skills, including the use of magic, wands, and a [[golden force]]-blade. She is proficient in various disciplines, ranging from piloting and tactical maneuvering to weapons repair and the art of distraction. Beyond her physical prowess, she exerts a powerful influence that can dominate a room and even the [[Aether]]. In her role as a leader, she has served as the Guardian of [[Shadow Ark]] and eventually assumed the position of [[Commander]] of the starship [[The Last Horizon]]. While she is a rebel queen who leads [[Karoshan forces]] and refugees, she maintains a strict sense of duty to her people. She is known for her high standards, her willingness to challenge others in contests of skill to prove her worth, and her refusal to accept any leadership role less than Captain.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|A [[Karoshan]] woman with dull bronze skin, golden eyes, and large yellow hands. Her hair consists of thick, glowing gold cable braids, and she wears ornate black battle armor featuring elaborate [[dragon]] designs. She also possesses a massive bronze fist.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|A determined leader and hunter who pursues victory at any cost. She is a focused commander driven by the goal of reclaiming [[Karosha]] and believes in monitoring specific individuals to ensure stability.}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|She is the sister of [[Prince Veshran|Veshran]] and the mother of children hidden from [[Felrex]], who also betrayed her. She is a teammate of the narrator, responds to the Captain's commands, and has taken [[Mell D-One-Twenty-Five|Mell]]. Additionally, she rallied forces against [[Starhammer]] and is a contact for [[Varic Vallenar|Varic]].}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Shyrax utilizes draconic magic to manifest a golden [[dragon]]'s wing for protection and uses [[telekinesis]]. As a journeyman [[Technicians|Technician]], she possesses the [[t’rshentha]] enhancement gift and can use magic for amplification. Her skills include [[Perfected infiltration]], projecting holograms from an [[optical implant]], and wielding a [[golden force]]-blade and a thick [[wand]].}}

{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|While serving as an [[Authority|authority]] figure on the bridge, Shyrax observes the energy capacity restrictions inherent to the [[Divine Titans]].<ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c42" /><ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c43">''The Knight'', chapter 43</ref> She actively supports the crew by providing tactical information and scans.<ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c44">''The Knight'', chapter 44</ref> Her duties include reporting on the status of the ship's shields while she is seen monitoring the distance via various screens.<ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c44" />}}

{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|As the [[Commander]] of [[The Last Horizon]], [[Queen]] Shyrax rules over the planet [[Basyrryx]] and possesses the ability to lend [[Technicians]].<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c4">''The Pilot'', chapter 4</ref><ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c6">''The Pilot'', chapter 6</ref> To protect her children from [[Felrex]], she has hidden them across the galaxy.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c6" /> Her spells are derived from a variant of draconic magic, and she was once served by the narrator, who acted as her bodyguard.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c7">''The Pilot'', chapter 7</ref> While studying monitors and checking sensor data, she inquired about the potential uses for [[Iron Hive]] core components.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c10">''The Pilot'', chapter 10</ref> After requesting the deployment of ships, her fist became covered in golden energy.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c14">''The Pilot'', chapter 14</ref> As a member of the crew, she nearly tore the bridge apart.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c16">''The Pilot'', chapter 16</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Guardian of Shadow Ark}} ===
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|[[Queen]] Shyrax serves as both the Guardian of [[Shadow Ark]] and the [[Commander]] of [[The Last Horizon]].<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c19">''The Pilot'', chapter 19</ref> She is the twin sister of [[Prince Veshran|Veshran]].<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c19" /> As a member of the crew, she possesses the ability to project footage using her [[optical implant]].<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c20">''The Pilot'', chapter 20</ref>}}

<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|[[Queen Shyrax|Shyrax]] has a twin brother named Prince Veshran{{!}}Veshran.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c19" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|[[Queen Shyrax|Shyrax]] is a member of the crew who can project footage from her [[optical implant]].<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c20" />}}</li>
</ul></div>

=== {{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Battle against Felrex}} ===
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Having previously fought against [[Felrex]], [[Queen]] Shyrax sits upon a gigantic chair while observing the battlefield.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c21">''The Pilot'', chapter 21</ref><ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c24">''The Pilot'', chapter 24</ref><ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c25">''The Pilot'', chapter 25</ref> She feels a sense of internal exultation after defeating the enemy, though she remains mindful that her children could be in danger if the ship were destroyed.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c24" /><ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c25" /> During combat, Shyrax issues orders and grants permission for personal engagement using a [[wand]] as thick as a human arm.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c28">''The Pilot'', chapter 28</ref><ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c29">''The Pilot'', chapter 29</ref> She directs the fleet via a [[communicator]] and [[console]], her jaw tightening during discussions where she expresses her belief that [[Omega]] does not deserve execution.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c30">''The Pilot'', chapter 30</ref> Claiming to be a hunter without peer, the [[Commander]] is distinguished by her massive bronze fist and thick cable braids that glow yellow.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c35">''The Pilot'', chapter 35</ref><ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c36">''The Pilot'', chapter 36</ref>}}
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">14</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|[[Queen Shyrax|Shyrax]] has fought against [[Felrex]].<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c21" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|[[Queen Shyrax|Shyrax]] has a gigantic chair.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c24" />}}</li>

<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|[[Commander]] [[Queen Shyrax|Shyrax]] has a braid of thick cables that glow yellow.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c36" />}}</li>

=== {{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Aftermath of the battle}} ===
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|A [[Karoshan]] and the sister of [[Prince Veshran|Veshran]], Shyrax experienced a betrayal by [[Felrex]] only a few years into her reign.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c36" /><ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c45">''The Pilot'', chapter 45</ref> Following a hull breach on her ship, she was observed floating within a debris field surrounded by pearls of [[blood]].<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c47">''The Pilot'', chapter 47</ref> While she was placed in Medical, it was noted that she would be the first to die should the [[Galactic Union]] target the [[Karoshan Alliance]].<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c48">''The Pilot'', chapter 48</ref><ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c49">''The Pilot'', chapter 49</ref>}}
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">6</span></div>

<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|[[Queen Shyrax|Shyrax]] is the sister of Prince Veshran{{!}}Veshran and a [[Karoshan]].<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c45" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|[[Queen Shyrax|Shyrax]] has a ship with a hull breach.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c47" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|[[Queen Shyrax|Shyrax]] was seen floating in a debris field with pearls of [[blood]].<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c47" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|[[Queen Shyrax|Shyrax]] would die first if the [[Galactic Union]] targeted the [[Karoshan Alliance]].<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c48" />}}</li>

== Notable quotes ==
* {{spoiler|book=lh-01-the-captain|“It was my understanding that we were competing for control of The Last Horizon,” she said.<ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c15" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=lh-01-the-captain|“Then I await my invitation. Until then, I have work to do.”<ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c15" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=lh-02-the-engineer|“Queen Shyrax the Third of the planet Karosha,” Horizon recited.<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c2" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=lh-02-the-engineer|“Do we interrupt other tasks to pursue a Zenith Device?” Shyrax asked.<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c19" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=lh-02-the-engineer|“Thank you, Your Highness.” “Commander,” she corrected.<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c39" />}}
